panels.title: Top devices by download
panels.description: Total bytes downloaded per device over the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and contains(value: r._field, set: ["rx_bytes"]))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with name: if exists r.name then r.name else r.ip}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "_value"])

panels.title: Download over time
panels.description: Bytes downloaded per device in each time bucket (at least 5 minutes).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and contains(value: r._field, set: ["rx_bytes"]))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with name: if exists r.name then r.name else r.ip}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Top apps by download
panels.description: Bytes downloaded per app identified by the router's deep packet inspection. Traffic it could not identify ("Other") is left out.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and contains(value: r._field, set: ["rx_bytes"]))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with name: if exists r.name then r.name else r.ip}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.app != "Other")
  |> group(columns: ["app"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["app", "_value"])

panels.title: Apps by device
panels.description: Download and upload per device and app over the selected time range. Click a column header to sort.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and contains(value: r._field, set: ["rx_bytes", "tx_bytes"]))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with name: if exists r.name then r.name else r.ip}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["name", "app", "category", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name", "app", "category"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["rx_bytes"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
